title: atlas.entity.create.v1 — result
description: Mint a new entity and return it. The id is minted by Atlas and never derived from the name, so renaming later cannot move it. This does NOT deduplicate: two calls make two entities, repairable by a merge, because guessing that two requests meant one thing is the conflation the identity model exists to prevent. Facts ABOUT the entity are separate assertions via atlas.assertion.propose.v1.
